hooks.text: 数百张卡和神器与迷你坦克升级叠加，构筑目标是组合出足以破坏平衡的火力。
hooks.excerpt: Shape your deck from hundreds of available cards, acquire powerful artifacts, and upgrade your mini-tank to get rid of the aliens once and for all.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每场战斗增加的核心资源是“知识”，玩家能在战斗中即时微调牌组以适应敌人规律。
hooks.excerpt: With roguelike progression at its core, each battle increases your most valuable resource – knowledge. Tweak your deck on the fly, adapt to enemy patterns, and discover powerful synergies as you fight to protect the Earth.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 指挥官自带不同起始牌组和能力，可从坦克纯力量转向毒素等完全不同流派。
hooks.excerpt: Pick from a roster of unique commanders, each bringing a different playstyle and starting deck to the battlefield. Wanna focus on the pure strength of your tank? Or maybe you want to play tricks on your opponents and focus more on the poison build?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 可爱视觉与策略压力形成独特愉快氛围。

excerpts.excerpt: Cute visuals paired with strategic tension create a uniquely enjoyable mood
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 可爱又阴险的坦克设计受到喜爱。
16:10屏幕也会裁掉部分游戏信息。

excerpts.excerpt: some parts of the game informations are cropped even in 16:10 ratio.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 翻译存在把射程10写成100的低级错误。

excerpts.excerpt: 范围内+10射程给你写成100的低级错误
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 局外成长极慢且刷取要求过重。

excerpts.excerpt: So Grindy and SLOW to meta progress
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 工具塔通常不如直接增加攻击塔，辅助选择缺乏价值。

excerpts.excerpt: Playing utility towers is almost never better than just playing another attacking tower.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 丢一抽一效果经常不生效。
多个减费效果会冲突并导致部分效果失效。

excerpts.excerpt: 多个减费之间也可能出现冲突导致某一个不生效
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多路出怪、多终点和空军叠加，进一步压缩塔防策略。

excerpts.excerpt: 多路出怪多终点加空军导致策略性很差
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 失败更像玩家自身判断失误，而非系统强制。

excerpts.excerpt: Even if you lose, it feels more like your fault then the game's.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
